attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is «Δομνίνος και οι συν αυτώ» and the page enumerates none of the company: it says only that several Christian virgins were martyred with him, so this folder is for Domninus alone.
